_source: Real game lines cited <log>:<line>: 1104 = Mahtra's 2026-11-04 Lich game log (angua logs/DR-Mahtra/2026/11/2026-11-04_14-08-52.log; Shard; Lich 5.23.0). 1104:30056: The attendant says, "You can purchase 30 yards of silk fiber for 135 Dokoras.  Just order it again and we'll see it done!"
1104:30058: The attendant takes some coins from you and hands you 30 yards of silk fiber.
1104:30060: You count out 10 yards of the fibers and mark it for cutting.
1104:30068: You carefully cut off 10 yards from some silk fibers and place the excess in your traveler's pack.
1104:30101: You combine the bundles of fiber together.
1104:30204: You carefully wrap some silk fibers around a large spinning wheel.
1104:30206: You adjust the wheel to spin heavy thread by allowing many of the fibers to droop freely.
1104:30215: The wheel rocks in the crook of your arm as you spin thread from the fiber around it.  On touch alone, your hands expertly pull the fiber into long strands of thread.
1104:30218: The wheel rocks in the crook of your arm as you spin thread from the fiber around it.  On touch alone, your hands expertly pull the fiber into long strands of thread.
1104:30219: The spun thread begins taking on a dull shade from grime trapped in the fiber.
1104:30226: You set the thread across your lap and lift up tufts of the fiber spun around it. Carefully, you comb out various debris caught up in the material.
1104:30230: You position your wheel against your leg and use both hands to draw its fiber out into thread.  On touch alone, your hands expertly pull the fiber into long strands of thread.
1104:30231: A counter-twist in the fiber strand threatens to unravel if not corrected.
1104:30244: Using both hands you begin turning the thread's strands back upon themselves while keeping the line taut.  When finished, the thread looks even once more.
1104:30254: You spin your wheel in one hand while gently pulling out a thread of fiber with the other.  Hand over hand you deftly spin fiber off the wheel and into thread on the spindle.
1104:30266: The spun thread begins taking on a dull shade from grime trapped in the fiber.
1104:30269: Wetting your fingers, you run them over the fibers atop your wheel and clean off several visible grime stains.
1104:30274: Slowly the fiber bundle begins to slide down the wheel and towards your hands.
1104:30281: You push the bundle of fiber back atop your wheel and untangle the many strands that have worked themselves free.
1104:30284: Back and forth you spin a thread of fiber from around your wheel onto a spool.  On touch alone, your hands expertly pull the fiber into long strands of thread.
1104:30286: You tie off the spool and are left with some heavy silk thread.
1104:30296: You put your thread in your traveler's pack.
